rules: Filter records where quality flags contain invalid values (0, 3); clamp temperature between -50 and 100°C; normalize pressure from hPa to kPa by dividing by 10; interpolate missing flow values only if gaps are ≤40 minutes using linear interpolation with corrected flag set to 'interpolated'; all rules are applied in sequence and justified by supplied material.
invariants: Output must have exactly one row per station per day; all numeric columns carry units in labels; sum of interpolated flags equals number of interpolation events; every record has a quality flag from {0,1,2,3}; any missing field triggers a halt; these are verified by cross-checking against raw input and cluster diagnostics.
